name: md-frontend-retirement
body: `solution.container.structural-scanner` occupies the role the retired Markdown frontend held. The system containment edge is `contains solution.system.apg → solution.container.structural-scanner`; the two `realised-by` edges from `domain.entity.engine-pin` and `domain.entity.frontend-artifact` stay on their seven remaining container targets, and those entity bodies state that the structural scanner realises `solution.container.structural-scanner` through `domain.entity.structural-scanner`. The Markdown frontend's code is absorbed into `src/structlib` (`rust.structfrontend.md`), whose Markdown parser/emitters sit under `solution.component.structural-scanner-crate` / `solution.component.structural-format-emitters`. `rust.mdfrontend` and its emitters are absent from the code graph (zero nodes match `rust.mdfrontend`; `rust.structfrontend.md` resolves).
